# Deutsche Nationalbibliothek {#sec-dnb}

The DNB catalogue is queried through its SRU interface. The CPS catalogue item carries a *DNB edition ID* (P44) and the artist has a *GND ID* (P25).

```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "src"))
from baldessari import cps, dnb, plots, table

```

## The catalogue record

```{python}
#| label: tbl-dnb-record
#| tbl-cap: "DNB record of the catalogue that is described in the CPS Wikibase."
idns = cps.catalogues()["dnbId"].dropna().tolist()
import pandas as pd
record = pd.concat([dnb.by_idn(i) for i in idns], ignore_index=True)
shown = record[["idn", "title", "subtitle", "place", "publisher", "year", "isbn"]]
shown.columns = ["DNB ID", "Title", "Subtitle", "Place", "Publisher", "Year", "ISBN"]
table(shown)
```

## Publications by and about John Baldessari

```{python}
#| label: dnb-search
pubs = dnb.about_baldessari()
```

A search for the person heading *Baldessari, John* returns **`{python} len(pubs)`** records.

```{python}
#| label: fig-dnb-years
#| fig-cap: "DNB records for John Baldessari by year of publication (five-year bins)."
plots.per_year(pubs)
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-dnb-publications
#| tbl-cap: "Most recent DNB records for John Baldessari."
shown = pubs.sort_values("year", ascending=False).head(25)[["year", "title", "publisher", "isbn"]]
shown.columns = ["Year", "Title", "Publisher", "ISBN"]
table(shown)
```
